QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: secondaryRtspUrl
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Feeds the second independent video window. Leave empty to disable the second video stream.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: primaryRtspTcpOnly
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Tries interleaved RTSP-over-TCP first for Video 1 and falls back to automatic transport negotiation if TCP cannot establish media.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: secondaryRtspTcpOnly
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Tries interleaved RTSP-over-TCP first for Video 2 and falls back to automatic transport negotiation if TCP cannot establish media.
